requirements.quote: I4: accept the lean annotations (`FORGE:CONTRACT` / `FORGE:PLAN`, plus `FORGE:WORK-ON` on the trajectory) as builder evidence, and apply the `stuck_hours_threshold` grace period before reporting CRITICAL.
I6: identify pipeline PRs by author (the configured bot or app) or by the lean head-branch pattern, as well as by body markers. Skip bot-authored dependency PRs such as dependabot.
An in-flight lean issue with `FORGE:CONTRACT` and no `FORGE:BUILDER` produces no I4 finding [type:unit]
A `workflow:building` issue younger than the threshold produces no CRITICAL [type:unit]
Lean-lane PRs and dependabot PRs produce no I6 warning; a hand-made PR with no markers still does [type:unit]

deliverables.change: I4: accept FORGE:BUILDER|CONTRACT|PLAN|WORK-ON as evidence and skip issues younger than STUCK_HOURS (fetch createdAt via gh issue view). Update header comment lines 44-46.
New node:test file running the script with a fake `gh` on PATH (temp dir) covering R3-R5 plus: old building issue with no annotations still CRITICAL; hand-made PR still warns.
